decisions.reason: The black-finish range builds on the firm's existing drainage lines at low incremental cost, and its move to a dedicated page in 2024 signals growing commitment, so keeping this option open is worthwhile.

The shower channel for seamless coverings has held its own page for two consecutive years, and the trend toward seamless bathrooms supports further investment, so its value appears to be materializing.

The pump-drain shower channel is only a year old and has a dedicated page, so its value is still uncertain and cheap to keep open, likely as the successor to the withdrawn pump solution C, and abandoning it now would be premature.
